body.statement: The independently defined directional form satisfies \[\inf_{\|\psi\|_2=1}\mathcal Q_c(\psi)=\Lambda_c=C_A\kappa(c)^{2/3}.\] The equality remains valid when \(V_c\) has flat transverse directions; no normalized full-dimensional ground state is required.
body.justification: This separates evaluation of the spectral benchmark from the unresolved transfer back to the statistical game.
body.gap: Levit's Schrödinger reduction and the scalar Airy theorem of Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen do not cover a directional operator with a polyhedral response-type potential and flat transverse directions.
body.consumer: The closed value supplies a normalization check for the response-alphabet gauge and the finite-data Airy construction.
